newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Volumes dive in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Volumes dive in quiet market.

text.p: - Activity slowed on the Lusaka Stock Exchange last week, exchange officials said.
They said volume fell to 46,605 shares valued at some 2.43 million kwacha, from 339,089 shares worth 11.18 million kwacha in the previous week.
Chilanga Cement remained steady at 54 kwacha and saw nine trades on turnover of 44,254 shares worth 2.39 million kwacha.
Rothmans fell one kwacha to end the week at 35 kwacha, and saw one trade of 500 shares worth 17,500 kwacha.
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) and Farmers House were untraded during the week.
